correct.description: Bar starts on the floor, hip-hinge down keeping the spine neutral, drive up to full hip and knee lockout, bar stays close to the body throughout

common_errors.description: Bar drifts away from the body instead of tracking close to the shins/thighs
Hips do not reach full extension at the top -- incomplete lockout
Lower back rounds under load instead of staying neutral -- the primary deadlift safety concern
common_errors.status_note: Lumbar (spinal) flexion under load during a deadlift is THE well-established deadlift injury risk, and the exact geometric threshold for 'rounding' vs. acceptable natural spinal curve is a genuine PT judgment call that varies by individual anatomy -- not something to invent from a shoulder/hip/knee angle proxy. PT sign-off required before this exercise goes vision-live at all (EXERCISE_LIBRARY.md §5 gate 5) -- this fault specifically needs that confirmation before any threshold is invented. No threshold value is seeded (see thresholds block: null).

keypoint_signature.rule: PROXY ONLY, not PT-confirmed: angle(shoulder, hip, knee) deviates from a neutral-spine reference by more than threshold.deadlift_lumbar_flexion_tolerance -- this proxy cannot distinguish spinal rounding from a normal hip-hinge torso angle without a direct spine-curvature measurement this pipeline doesn't have. Do not implement against this rule without PT sign-off.

thresholds._status: SEED values only -- placeholders pending real field-measured tuning per EXERCISE_LIBRARY.md §4. Not authoritative; do not treat as validated. deadlift_lumbar_flexion_tolerance is intentionally null -- see the lumbar_flexion fault's status_note.

rep_counting._note: "top" = standing lockout (rest reference, highest hip angle), "bottom" = hip-hinged with the bar low (peak flexion) -- same top=rest/bottom=effort convention as squat.json. Primary signal is hip angle (hinge), not knee angle -- knee_angle_at_bottom is tracked as a secondary reference key_angle only.

coaching_cues.setup: Bar over mid-foot, grip just outside your knees
coaching_cues.execution: Hinge at the hips, drive through your heels
coaching_cues.set_complete_no_flags: Strong set. Clean bar path every rep.
coaching_cues.set_complete_with_flags: Good set. Next time, watch your {flag_body_part} — {flag_cue}.

flag_cues.bar_path_drift: Keep the bar close to your body
flag_cues.lockout_rom: Drive your hips all the way through
flag_cues.lumbar_flexion: Keep your back flat, hinge at the hips

back_injury.modification: This exercise carries meaningful lower-back load. Consider a trap-bar or Romanian variation, reduced weight, and in-person coaching before loading heavily. Stop if you feel lumbar pressure.

knee_injury.modification: Reduce weight and range of motion. Stop if you feel knee pain.

hypertension.modification: Avoid breath-holding (Valsalva). Breathe out as you stand up.

model_assist.notes: Advisory only (ADR-100/102). Cannot override rep count or safety flags -- and per this contract's hard rule, cannot substitute for PT confirmation on the lumbar_flexion fault's threshold either. Default off until expert-agreement eval passes; this exercise additionally requires PT sign-off before any form flag ships at all (EXERCISE_LIBRARY.md §5 gate 5).
